title: DeepSWE task comparison
kind: Project evaluation snapshot; not an official leaderboard result

source.tasks: DeepSWE v1.1, as included in FrontierHarness Eval v1

methodology.correctness: Sum of per-task medians of passed custom automated checks, divided by 464. Scored samples vary from 2 to 8 per task-agent cell.
methodology.cacheRate: Sum of per-task median cached input tokens divided by sum of per-task median input tokens.
methodology.duration: Sum of per-task median wall-clock durations, in minutes.
methodology.requests: Sum of per-task median captured model request counts. Historical report labels these as turns.
methodology.scope: Correctness and efficiency were aggregated separately. Efficiency uses successful process exits; these do not imply task correctness. Sample IDs and complete run configurations are not included in this snapshot.

limitations: Custom automated checks, not the official DeepSWE or Terminal-Bench verifier.
Check pass rate is not the fraction of fully solved tasks.
Repeated sample counts vary; there is no statistical significance analysis.
Efficiency samples were not strictly matched to scored run IDs or a single frozen configuration batch.
Concurrent runs and incomplete environment and version records limit speed comparisons.
This aggregate snapshot supports regenerating the chart, not reproducing the full experiment.
